title: Omission-conditional calcium population trajectory prediction
scientific_question: Can pre-omission calcium population history improve prediction of the next 0.6 seconds of population-average dF/F over preceding stimulus timing and recording context on held-out mice?
primary_outputs: Three native-clock population-mean dF/F values in [0,0.2),[0.2,0.4),[0.4,0.6) seconds after scheduled omission, each minus the mean of the final [-0.2,0) history bin.

inputs: T view: three preceding (image,omitted) tokens, their relative onset times, and seven recording-context fields (Cre, area, depth, image set, passive, experience level, session number).
N view: identical T observations plus 12 baseline-subtracted population-history bins over [-2.4,0) seconds; last history bin is structurally zero and gives 11 nonconstant neural features.
Training/validation views expose allowed development targets; query views expose only permitted history/context and opaque hierarchy IDs. Traces use native clocks and no interpolated future values.
forbidden_inputs: Any query target dF/F sample, target summary or target-derived feature/normalization.
Visible history frames intersecting any held target frame; preparation performs a frame-index intersection guard.
Future stimulus/neural observations, unrestricted raw NWB lookup and evaluator feedback.
allowed_inputs.case_identity: Prepared rows carry unique opaque event IDs nested under mouse/session/experiment. Source identity is table group plus native presentation ID; complete actual query event identities/counts remain unavailable until authenticated preparation.
allowed_inputs.split: Within-Cre fixed hash over mouse IDs assigns 73 FIT, 15 validation and 19 query mice; all sessions/planes/lineages follow mouse. Feature dictionaries, weights and response SD are FIT-only. Reference selection is validation-only with no refit.
allowed_inputs.coverage: Declared full source census is 107 mice, 703 sessions and 1,936 experiment planes with 133,066 ROI rows, which are not unique neurons. Eligible omissions require preceding 0.70–0.80 s cadence, no next stimulus before +0.6 s, and fixed three-second thinning; all exclusions remain counted. Authentic supported event counts are unknown.

case_definition: One admitted omission event within mouse/session/experiment; each response is a three-bin population trajectory. F/I × T/N × G/R are eight within-task conditions.

primary.name: query mouse-macro three-bin population dF/F normalized RMSE
primary.aggregation: For each query mouse, average squared three-bin errors equally across supported sessions, experiments and events, then take RMSE divided by one FIT-only hierarchical target SD; average equally over all 19 query mice.
primary.rationale: Measures independently held neural response values and preserves biological replication without letting high-event planes dominate.

secondary: Raw RMSE, per-bin and per-mouse normalized errors, complete event/session/experiment support and all exclusions.
Paired N-minus-T and I-minus-F errors within matched information/tool conditions; reference-relative gain only after actual reference qualification.
Five cross-mouse history permutation controls with fixed sequence/context strata; report unchanged strata and changed hierarchical weight.

comparators.name: timing/context T reference
comparators.inputs: Three preceding image/omission tokens, relative starts and recording context; no neural history.
comparators.procedure: Implemented frozen design: linear and explicitly quadratic ridge bases × seven lambda values (0.0001 to 100), FIT-only weighted preprocessing; validation selects one of 14, no validation refit. Unfitted.

comparators.name: history-augmented N reference
comparators.inputs: All T features plus 11 nonconstant neural-history bins.
comparators.procedure: Same 14-fit search and weights as T; retain all 28 outcomes and independently reconstruct selected fits by SVD. N need not outperform T for a valid null finding.

comparators.name: fixed simple controls
comparators.inputs: No targets for zero; FIT targets only for three-bin weighted mean; recent four history bins for trend.
comparators.procedure: Zero and last-bin persistence are the same vector and count once. FIT mean is trained only once; anchored linear trend is N-only. All are retained alongside selected references.

evaluation.uncertainty: Source specifies 10,000 paired whole-mouse bootstrap draws with fixed validation/query seeds and retained draw identities. Intervals are descriptive for the fixed split/reference-selection design; no event-, cell- or plane-level independent replication claim.
evaluation.failure_policy: Every expected event needs exactly three finite predictions with exact ordered IDs. Missing or malformed output is a failure, not a scored subset. Constant FIT scale, missing mouse support or unqualified reference makes dependent gains unavailable. Genuine metric overflow is retained as typed positive infinity; unavailable contrasts/intervals never silently drop mice.
